title: fleet scripts: check-half-states H14/H15/H67 stop ranking pm:blocking above p1 (follow-up of #35223)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Source: topic #35205

Filing gate: owed follow-up named in the acceptance notes of PR #35223 (L1 6988050932, item C1); child of epic #35205. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: p3 · area:fleet · Task · blocks no running work

Blocked-by: #35223

## What to do

`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H14, H15 and H67 still model `pm:blocking` as a rank above p1, and H14 derives it without knowing which area is being dispatched. Under the rules #35223 lands, a card blocking another p1 takes that grade, and dispatch goes by epic and area. These checks must stop treating `pm:blocking` as a rank of its own.

## Done when

H14, H15 and H67 read the grade the rules give, and no rule ranks `pm:blocking` above p1. The self-tests cover it.
